doc: Steep-stair traversal (M3-ARC-1216, ADR 0193): flights too steep for the field controller's 45° floor limit (Ashcrown's 48° flying stair, its 60° vein stairs) are walked on a marked path instead of their collision. HeroStairFlight marks one (foot, run, rise, width); HeroStairs (on the field player) takes the player along it, and followers and NPCs read its height with HeroStairs.height_at. Metres and metres per second. slope_speed_mps: the most the body moves along the flight's slope while walking (its horizontal speed is this times the slope's cosine, so a 60° flight is climbed slower across the ground than a 48° one; the gait blend sees a slow walk). slope_run_speed_mps: the same while running (a full stick; the motor's intent above walk speed): a stair run, so the 62 m flying stair at Ashcrown takes ~33 s, not a minute (the Lead's 10-29 walk audit). Followers and NPCs are capped at the running one (they keep the player's pace). enter_m: how far before the foot or past the head the flight takes the player when walking in (before its blocking collision can), and how far past an end it lets them go onto the landing. height_tolerance_m: a body is on a flight only within this of its profile (walking under a flying stair is not walking on it). side_margin_m: the player stays this far inside the flight's edges. step_rise_m: a flight's default riser height when it names none. riser_share: the share of each step's run the root rises over (the rest is flat tread), so the root steps up tread by tread, eased, never a ramp and never a jump.
